notfound.headline: Page not found
notfound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist, has been moved, or has been removed.

boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.headline: An unexpected system error occurred
boundary.description: An error occurred while loading this section of the application. Please try again later.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.headline: Please wait a moment
rate_limited.description: You have sent too many requests in a short period of time. Please wait a moment before trying again.

internal_server_error.title: Server error
internal_server_error.headline: The system is currently unavailable
internal_server_error.description: A server error occurred while processing your request. Your data is safe. Please try again later.
